name: PathPurge SVG
problem: Exported SVGs contain bloated paths, redundant commands, and excessive decimal precision that increase asset size and complicate CSS animations.
pain: Command-line optimizers lack an interactive visual preview of how individual path changes (like rounding decimals or converting absolute to relative commands) affect the rendering.
solution: A local-first SVG editor that parses path data, displays an interactive visual canvas showing control points, and provides granular sliders to adjust decimal precision, toggle relative/absolute commands, and instantly export optimized SVG code.
verification: Load an SVG path string with high decimal precision, apply a precision-reduction filter via JavaScript, and assert that the resulting path string length is reduced while rendering correctly on an HTML5 canvas.
major_features: Precision decimal rounder with live visual canvas preview
